mode.help: Who links work for: lan = devices on this network, internet = anyone (through a Cloudflare tunnel)

port.help: Port links use on the LAN or with --public (the next free one is used if it's taken)

once.help: Stop each link after one completed download

window.help: Open the sharing window as an app window instead of a browser tab

cloudflared.help: cloudflared program for internet links (empty: the one on PATH, else kit downloads it)
